Penn Quarter.name: Penn Quarter
Penn Quarter.description: Museum-and-theater core between the Mall and Gallery Place with Capital One Arena foot traffic, office-to-residential conversions, and the heaviest downtown permit velocity.

Southwest Waterfront/The Wharf.name: Southwest Waterfront/The Wharf
Southwest Waterfront/The Wharf.description: Phased mixed-use waterfront rebuild along Maine Avenue with The Wharf's concert piers, hotel inventory, and continued phase-two infill toward the Arena Stage axis.

NoMa/H Street NE.name: NoMa/H Street NE
NoMa/H Street NE.description: Red Line-anchored high-density residential boom north of Union Station feeding the H Street NE streetcar nightlife spine across the Florida Avenue gap.

Union Market.name: Union Market
Union Market.description: Food-hall epicenter of a master-planned five-million-square-foot development district where Edison-era warehouse fabric meets tower cranes along Neal Place.

Capitol Hill.name: Capitol Hill
Capitol Hill.description: Rowhouse historic district of congressional staff housing east of the Capitol grounds with Barracks Row retail and tight single-family supply.

Eastern Market.name: Eastern Market
Eastern Market.description: Landmark 1873 public-market square anchoring weekend vendor crowds, 7th Street SE boutiques, and premium rowhouse renovations on Capitol Hill's north slope.

Dupont Circle.name: Dupont Circle
Dupont Circle.description: Embassy-row traffic circle with Connecticut Avenue Class-B office stock converting to residential, gallery retail, and Metro Red Line density.

Kalorama Heights.name: Kalorama Heights
Kalorama Heights.description: Mansion-belt enclave of presidential residencies and embassy compounds where turnover is rare and renovation permits carry outsized contract values.

Adams Morgan.name: Adams Morgan
Adams Morgan.description: Nightlife-and-immigration commercial strip on 18th Street with aging walk-up stock primed for repositioning and Columbia Road corridor investment.

U Street Corridor.name: U Street Corridor
U Street Corridor.description: Black Broadway heritage corridor of music venues and Victorian rowhouses now ringed by Green/Yellow Line transit-oriented tower development.

Georgetown Waterfront.name: Georgetown Waterfront
Georgetown Waterfront.description: Federal-row retail and Washington Harbour park frontage on the Potomac with luxury condo scarcity value and C&O Canal-adjacent restoration work.

Foggy Bottom/West End.name: Foggy Bottom/West End
Foggy Bottom/West End.description: George Washington University hospital-and-dormitory economy beside the Kennedy Center, with State Department demand and West End condo redevelopment.

Columbia Heights.name: Columbia Heights
Columbia Heights.description: Green/Yellow Line retail hub around DC USA with dense multifamily conversion pipeline along 14th Street NW's northern stretch.

Petworth.name: Petworth
Petworth.description: Porched-rowhouse family market around Upshur Street strip retail with steady gut-renovation velocity and Georgia Avenue investment frontage.

Takoma DC.name: Takoma DC
Takoma DC.description: Historic bungalow quarter at the Maryland line around the Takoma Metro station with craftsman restoration work and small-lot infill.

Brookland/CUA.name: Brookland/CUA
Brookland/CUA.description: Little Rome university district where Catholic University institutional demand meets Arts Walk mixed-use build-out on the Rhode Island Avenue bridge.

Anacostia Historic District.name: Anacostia Historic District
Anacostia Historic District.description: Frederick Douglass home-side cottage district around the 11th Street Bridge landing where the Bridge District waterfront project resets East-of-the-River values.

Congress Heights/St. Elizabeths.name: Congress Heights/St. Elizabeths
Congress Heights/St. Elizabeths.description: Camp Simms retail rebuild and the St. Elizabeths campus conversion — DHS headquarters, hospital shell reuse, and the district's largest land-bank opportunity.
